messages:
mara: Heads-up — HeliosLabs (acct:helios-77) disputed invoice INV-2026-089, saying Dedicated burst looks inflated. They attached CSV and asked for immediate reconciliation. :exclamation:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-089 generated 2026-04-05T09:14Z — total_due $22,300 — https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-089
samir: Can someone paste the billed usage lines? I want to confirm committed vs burst math before replying.
natalie: Quick read: contract commits 100k tokens/month. Pre-bill export shows 220k total for period → 120k burst. Customer CSV shows a burst quantity of 240k. That extra 120k smells like duplication, not actual usage. :thinking_face:
eli: pulling raw events now. preliminary sample (sanitized):
```
2026-04-04T23:12:01Z,helios-77,committed,100000,event_id=evt-abc123
2026-04-05T06:45:12Z,helios-77,burst,120000,event_id=evt-def456
2026-04-05T06:45:15Z,helios-77,burst,120000,event_id=evt-def456  # duplicate due to consumer retry
```
eli: root cause appears to be non-idempotent writes when kafka consumer reprocessed the same partition after an ACK flake. I can reprocess after dedupe and upload corrected CSV to s3://billing-exports/2026/04/helios-77/corrected.csv by EOD.
mara: Ok. Pause collection on INV-2026-089 and flag for corrective invoice if dedupe shows duplication. Estimated erroneous charge ~ $9,600 (provisional). Note: credits over $5k require finance lead sign-off. @anna please advise.
anna: Thanks — please submit the provisional credit request with supporting export and ticket. I can approve up to $10k provisional from my desk; above that needs CFO review. Create ledger hold LH-2026-051 and block collection.
samir: Messaging HeliosLabs now: "We're investigating an ingestion issue that may have duplicated burst rows. We'll pause collection and will send a provisional credit memo pending final reconciliation (target 48h)."
natalie: Procurement at Helios asked for a proforma credit note to present to their AP team. I'll draft it once finance confirms provisional amount.
eli: mitigation: redeployed billing-consumer with idempotency fix (kubectl rollout restart deploy/billing-consumer -n prod). I'll run dedupe job and post corrected export to s3 and attach to TICKET-5391.
mara: Approve provisional hold and provisional credit $9,600 pending final recon. Finance, please tag ledger LH-2026-051 and mark invoice as collection_hold.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-089 status -> collection_hold; ticket TICKET-5391 created.
mara: Great. Once eli confirms corrected export and we reconcile the token counts, finance will post the final credit and reissue the invoice. Natalie — keep HeliosLabs updated; aim to close this in 48h. :thumbsup:
